# Adding Second AWS Region (us-west-2) via Crossplane Provider Config

## Approach

Add a second `ProviderConfig` for `us-west-2` and update the composition to support cross-region S3 replication for prod. Existing claims remain untouched.

## 1. Add ProviderConfig for us-west-2

```yaml
# provider-config-us-west-2.yaml
apiVersion: aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-us-west-2
spec:
  credentials:
    source: Secret
    secretRef:
      namespace: crossplane-system
      name: aws-creds
      key: creds
  region: us-west-2
```

## 2. Update Composition with Replication Support

```yaml
# composition.yaml (updated)
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: webapp-composition
  labels:
    provider: aws
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: example.org/v1alpha1
    kind: XWebApp
  patchSets:
    - name: metadata
      patches:
        - fromFieldPath: metadata.labels
  resources:
    # ... existing resources (EKS, RDS, IAM, etc.) unchanged ...
    
    # Primary S3 Bucket (existing - unchanged)
    - name: s3-bucket
      base:
        apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Bucket
        spec:
          forProvider:
            region: us-east-1
            versioningConfiguration:
              status: Enabled
            serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
              rules:
                - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                    sseAlgorithm: AES256
            publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
              blockPublicAcls: true
              blockPublicPolicy: true
              ignorePublicAcls: true
              restrictPublicBuckets: true
          providerConfigRef:
            name: aws-us-east-1
      patches:
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels[environment]
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
        - type: PatchSet
          patchSetName: metadata

    # NEW: Replication Bucket in us-west-2 (prod only)
    - name: s3-replication-bucket
      base:
        apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Bucket
        spec:
          forProvider:
            region: us-west-2
            versioningConfiguration:
              status: Enabled
            serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
              rules:
                - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                    sseAlgorithm: AES256
            publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
              blockPublicAcls: true
              blockPublicPolicy: true
              ignorePublicAcls: true
              restrictPublicBuckets: true
          providerConfigRef:
            name: aws-us-west-2  # Second region
      patches:
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels[environment]
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
            - type: string
              string:
                fmt: "%s-replica"
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.enableReplication
          toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
          transforms:
            - type: map
              map:
                "false": "skip-replication"
        - type: PatchSet
          patchSetName: metadata
      # Only create for prod
      readinessChecks:
        - type: None

    # NEW: IAM Role for Replication (prod only)
    - name: s3-replication-role
      base:
        apiVersion: iam.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Role
        spec:
          forProvider:
            assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
              {
                "Version": "2012-10-17",
                "Statement": [{
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Principal": {"Service": "s3.amazonaws.com"},
                  "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                }]
              }
          providerConfigRef:
            name: aws-us-east-1
      patches:
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
            - type: string
              string:
                fmt: "%s-replication-role"

    # NEW: Replication Policy
    - name: s3-replication-policy
      base:
        apiVersion: iam.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: RolePolicy
        spec:
          forProvider:
            roleNameSelector:
              matchControllerRef: true
            policyDocument: |
              {
                "Version": "2012-10-17",
                "Statement": [
                  {
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Action": [
                      "s3:GetReplicationConfiguration",
                      "s3:ListBucket"
                    ],
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::SOURCE_BUCKET"
                  },
                  {
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Action": [
                      "s3:GetObjectVersion",
                      "s3:GetObjectVersionAcl"
                    ],
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::SOURCE_BUCKET/*"
                  },
                  {
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Action": [
                      "s3:ReplicateObject",
                      "s3:ReplicateDelete"
                    ],
                    "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DEST_BUCKET/*"
                  }
                ]
              }
          providerConfigRef:
            name: aws-us-east-1
      patches:
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
            - type: string
              string:
                fmt: "%s-replication-policy"

    # Update primary bucket with replication config (prod only)
    - name: s3-bucket-replication
      base:
        apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: BucketReplication
        spec:
          forProvider:
            bucketNameSelector:
              matchControllerRef: true
            replicationConfiguration:
              roleSelector:
                matchControllerRef: true
              rules:
                - id: replicate-all
                  status: Enabled
                  destination:
                    bucketSelector:
                      matchLabels:
                        replication-target: "true"
          providerConfigRef:
            name: aws-us-east-1
      patches:
        - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.enableReplication
          toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[replication-enabled]
```

## 3. Updated Composite Resource Definition (XRD)

```yaml
# xrd.yaml (add enableReplication parameter)
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xwebapps.example.org
spec:
  group: example.org
  names:
    kind: XWebApp
    plural: xwebapps
  claimNames:
    kind: WebApp
    plural: webapps
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                parameters:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    environment:
                      type: string
                      enum: [dev, prod]
                    region:
                      type: string
                    bucketName:
                      type: string
                    nodeCount:
                      type: integer
                    nodeInstanceType:
                      type: string
                    dbInstanceClass:
                      type: string
                    dbMultiAZ:
                      type: boolean
                    enableReplication:  # NEW
                      type: boolean
                      default: false
                  required:
                    - environment
                    - region
                    - bucketName
```

## 4. Environment-Specific Claims (unchanged)

Existing claims work without modification. Replication only activates when `enableReplication: true`:

```yaml
# claims/prod.yaml (existing - now with replication enabled)
apiVersion: example.org/v1alpha1
kind: WebApp
metadata:
  name: webapp-prod
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: prod
    region: us-east-1
    bucketName: webapp-prod-assets
    nodeCount: 4
    nodeInstanceType: t3.large
    dbInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
    dbMultiAZ: true
    enableReplication: true  # NEW: triggers us-west-2 resources
  resourceRef:
    apiVersion: example.org/v1alpha1
    kind: XWebApp
    name: webapp-prod-xrd
```

```yaml
# claims/dev.yaml (unchanged - no replication)
apiVersion: example.org/v1alpha1
kind: WebApp
metadata:
  name: webapp-dev
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: dev
    region: us-east-1
    bucketName: webapp-dev-assets
    nodeCount: 2
    nodeInstanceType: t3.medium
    dbInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
    dbMultiAZ: false
    enableReplication: false  # Explicitly disabled
  resourceRef:
    apiVersion: example.org/v1alpha1
    kind: XWebApp
    name: webapp-dev-xrd
```

## 5. Conditional Resource Creation

To make replication resources conditional, use Crossplane's `Composition` functions or split into two compositions:

**Option A: Separate Prod Composition**

```yaml
# composition-prod.yaml (includes replication)
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: webapp-composition-prod
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: example.org/v1alpha1
    kind: XWebApp
  # ... includes all resources + replication resources ...
```

**Option B: Use Composition Functions (recommended)**

```yaml
# composition.yaml with function
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: webapp-composition
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: example.org/v1alpha1
    kind: XWebApp
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    - step: conditional-replication
      functionRef:
        name: function-conditional
      input:
        apiVersion: template.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Input
        condition: spec.parameters.enableReplication == true
        resources:
          - s3-replication-bucket
          - s3-replication-role
          - s3-replication-policy
          - s3-bucket-replication
```

## Summary

- **ProviderConfig**: Added `aws-us-west-2` for second region
- **Composition**: Added replication bucket, IAM role/policy, and replication config
- **Claims**: Unchanged; `enableReplication` parameter controls conditional creation
- **Isolation**: Dev never creates us-west-2 resources; prod optionally enables replication

Apply with:
```bash
kubectl apply -f provider-config-us-west-2.yaml
kubectl apply -f composition.yaml
# Existing claims continue working
kubectl get webapps
```
